meta_title: Repotify: the right agent skills for your repo, vetted and conflict-free
meta_description: Repotify picks a vetted, conflict-free set of agent skills, MCP servers and tools for your project and installs them safely into Claude Code, Cursor, Codex or Gemini CLI. Open source, zero dependencies.
hero_lead: Repotify reads your project, picks a vetted, conflict-free set of agent skills, MCP servers and tools, and installs them safely into Claude Code, Cursor, Codex or Gemini CLI.
hero_hint: Run it in your project folder
why_title: Your agent is only as good as what you give it
why_1_text: One discovery pass found 4,377 repositories of agent skills. Which ones fit your project?
why_2_text: A skill is a set of instructions your agent follows. A malicious one can run commands on your machine.
why_3_text: Every skill takes room in your agent's context. Useless ones slow it down and distract it.
how_title: From a project to a pro setup in four steps
how_lead: The whole flow costs your agent about 4,700 tokens.
step_1_text: A local scan of manifests and file names. Your code is never read or sent.
step_2_text: At most three questions, and only what the project does not already answer.
step_3_text: One best item per job, chosen by evidence, platform and coverage, within a context budget.
step_4_text: Pinned commits, SHA-256 checks and a local re-scan. Hooks and MCP servers only when you switch them on.
new_1_text: Excel in your dependencies brings the spreadsheet skill, not Word and PowerPoint. Mobile apps get no web-only skills. Every pick covers something nothing else does.
new_2_text: `repotify audit` judges the skills already in your project: keep, consider removing or remove, each with the reason.
new_3_text: `repotify suggest` scans your repository locally and fills in the catalog form. Nothing is sent until you submit it.
new_4_text: Your agent installs skills. Hooks and MCP servers change how it runs, so only you switch them on.
sec_lead: A rule-based scanner decides trust. The LLM jury can add suspicion, never remove it.
level_caution: A finding worth a look. Installed only with your consent.
level_quarantined: High risk. Held until a human reviews that exact commit.
level_rejected: Critical risk. Kept out of the catalog.
sec_point_1: Reads shell commands the way a shell does and URLs the way curl does.
sec_point_2: Third-party items are pinned to a commit and never update silently.
sec_point_3: Tools are never run for you: Repotify shows the steps.
num_1: expected items recommended across 44 project scenarios
cmd_start: Installs the repotify skill for your agent and prints the project fingerprint
cmd_recommend: Conflict-free candidate table within your context budget
cmd_install: Installs the skills you picked: pinned, hash-checked, re-scanned
cmd_enable: Switches on a hook or MCP server after showing you the change
cmd_audit: Judges installed skills: keep, consider removing or remove, with the reason
cmd_suggest: Offers your own skill to the catalog; nothing is sent
cmd_scan: Runs the security scanner on any skill folder
changes_title: What it changes on your machine
changes_1: The first run writes your agent's repotify skill and a lock file. Nothing else.
changes_2: `install` writes only skill folders; `enable` writes only what it showed you first.
faq_1_a: No. It reads manifests (package.json, pyproject.toml, go.mod…) and file names on your machine, and sends nothing about your project anywhere.
faq_2_q: Can my agent switch on hooks or MCP servers by itself?
faq_2_a: No. They change how the agent runs, so `repotify enable` asks you in a terminal, and the skill tells agents to hand you the command.
faq_3_a: Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Gemini CLI and any agent that reads .agents/skills.
faq_4_a: Yes. Repotify is open source under the MIT license. Catalog items keep their own licenses.
faq_5_q: How do I get my skill into the catalog?
faq_5_a: Run `repotify suggest` in its repository. It scans it locally and gives you a pre-filled form; the catalog's security gate and LLM jury review it.
faq_6_a: It is built to learn from anonymous signals, but the collection endpoint is not configured, so nothing is sent. Opt out any time with REPOTIFY_TELEMETRY=0.
final_title: Give your agent the right tools
final_text: One command in your project folder. Everything it installs, you can see and undo.
footer_tagline: Made for developers who let agents write code.
